summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release updating progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 April 2026. During the week of 18–22 May 2026, ING repurchased 1,775,000 shares at an average price of €25.77 for €45.7 million. Cumulative repurchases total 6,150,000 shares at an average price of €25.31, representing 15.57% of the programme's maximum value. The programme aims to reduce share capital. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or special mechanics are noted. What to watch: continued execution against the €1.0 billion target and impact on capital ratios.
